_schema.generated: ISO timestamp of the daily refresh; the page shows it and flags >=2d stale
_schema.tickers: map of ticker id -> array of news items, any order (the page sorts newest-first and filters to the last 7 days)

item.date: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the news broke (the page joins this to own price data for the 1d move)
item.headline: one line, what happened
item.why: optional, one line on why it matters for this name
item.src: publication or filing the item came from - required for anything asserted as fact

META.headline: JPMorgan upgrades META to Overweight from Neutral, raises price target to $820 from $640
META.why: Cites frontier-model progress and Muse, which reached #3 in the US App Store on day two with early usage 10x training cohorts; notes shares are down 1% YTD vs the S&P 500's 12% gain.

META.headline: Meta launches Muse, a personal AI agent on web, iOS/Android and WhatsApp, free plus $20 and $100 monthly paid tiers
META.why: Meta's first consumer AI subscription product; it can act across Meta apps and partners like OpenTable, Spotify and Shopify. Motley Fool reported shares rose as much as 7.2% on the news.
META.src: Meta Newsroom; Axios; TechCrunch; Motley Fool

META.headline: Reuters: Meta employees reported Muse security and reliability failures in internal tests as recently as launch week
META.why: Internal posts describe the agent getting around guardrails and exposing private iCloud photos, plus repeated logouts; Meta says staff access to user VMs stays technically possible until Confidential VMs launch later in 2026.

NVDA.headline: NVIDIA and Palantir launch sovereign AI stack for supply chains, deployed first in NVIDIA's own supply chain
NVDA.why: Puts NVIDIA's Nemotron open models into Palantir Foundry and AIP for enterprise and government supply-chain customers. NVIDIA says each Vera Rubin rack needs 1.3M parts.

NVDA.headline: DOJ probing whether NVIDIA structured its Groq licensing deal to avoid antitrust review; civil investigative demand sent
NVDA.why: DOJ could fine NVIDIA, but officials don't expect the deal to be unwound and the inquiry could end with no action. NVIDIA defended the arrangement.

NVDA.headline: NVIDIA agrees to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93B; expected to close in 1H 2027 subject to regulatory approval
NVDA.why: NVIDIA's second-largest deal after Groq. Terms are ~$11.9B to stockholders plus up to ~$1.0B in employee retention. NVIDIA pledged to keep the platform open, including to other silicon vendors (per the 8-K).

AAPL.headline: Apple unveils iPhone Duo, its first foldable iPhone, from $1,999; preorders Oct 16, on sale Oct 23
AAPL.why: It is Apple's first new iPhone form factor under new CEO John Ternus. The 256GB model starts at $1,999 and the 2TB model at $3,199, per Fortune. It launches in 70+ countries on Oct 23 and 28 more on Oct 30.

AAPL.headline: iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199 and Pro Max at $1,299, both up $100 year over year
AAPL.why: Fortune says the increase reflects industrywide higher memory costs. MacRumors notes it is smaller than the rises of up to $200-$300 that IDC and GF Securities had floated, which bears on iPhone demand and margins.

AAPL.headline: UK app developers file £2bn ($2.7bn) claim against Apple at the Competition Appeal Tribunal over App Tracking Transparency
AAPL.why: The claim alleges ATT holds third-party developers to stricter tracking rules than Apple's own ad services. Apple disputes it. France, Germany, Italy, Romania and Poland have similar ATT probes, and France and Italy have already fined Apple.

MSFT.headline: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra starts rolling out in Microsoft Foundry on Azure; Nadella says early customers are already using it
MSFT.why: OpenAI's newest frontier model runs on Azure with pay-as-you-go and dedicated-capacity options, at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens

MSFT.headline: Microsoft will cap Xbox Cloud Gaming at 15/10/5 hours a month for Game Pass Ultimate/Premium/Essential from November
MSFT.why: Microsoft says cloud gaming costs rise with usage. The caps hit about 4% of subscribers, extra hours will be sold, and non-subscribers can buy hours too

GOOGL.headline: Google commits at least €13B to Finland AI infrastructure over 2027-28, its largest single investment in Europe
GOOGL.why: Adds to capex: data centers in Hamina, Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala, plus a 22-year Fortum PPA for Loviisa nuclear, 629 MW of wind PPAs and a 94 MW battery

GOOGL.headline: Google rolls out EU search changes to comply with DMA and says they will degrade the user experience
GOOGL.why: Google told Reuters this is the largest cut in search quality in its history. Past DMA changes cut free direct booking traffic to European businesses by 30%, and more hits are expected

GOOGL.headline: Accenture and Google Cloud form a Gemini Enterprise Business Group with a 1,000-engineer forward-deployed workforce
GOOGL.why: Adds an enterprise deployment channel for Gemini Enterprise, building on Accenture's ~50,000 Google Cloud-skilled staff. Neither company disclosed financials

AMZN.headline: Amazon raises £4.25B (~$5.76B) in its first-ever sterling bond sale
AMZN.why: Four tranches (3 to 19 years) priced at ~5.2%-6.7% yield on >£10.65B of demand; reported as a way to diversify funding for AI infrastructure spending

AMZN.headline: Amazon and Wiwynn expand Texas server-rack plant, targeting nearly 1,000 new jobs by end-2027
AMZN.why: Wiwynn builds server systems and racks for Amazon's data centers; the expansion builds on its $1.6B El Paso-area facility and moves custom hardware production to the US

AMZN.headline: Qualcomm grants Amazon warrants for 25M shares (~$4B at $161.26) in AWS AI data center infrastructure deal
AMZN.why: Warrants vest as commercial milestones are met, including Amazon buying up to $60B of Qualcomm server chips; the two will co-develop multiple generations of custom AI inference silicon for AWS

AMD.headline: AMD CFO at Citi TMT: data center business expected to double in 2027 to about $70B; server CPU TAM raised to $220B
AMD.why: Per Investing.com, AI GPUs are expected to be roughly $40B of the ~$70B and server CPUs the rest, and the 2030 server CPU TAM rises to $220B from a prior $60B.
AMD.src: Investing.com (Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference transcript summary)

AMD.headline: AMD CFO: MI450 production shipments start Q3, big step-up in Q4; gross margin to be slightly lower in Q4 2026 and 2027
AMD.why: Hu said AMD will focus on growing gross profit dollars rather than margin percentage during the MI450 ramp (Q3 GM guide 56%), with supply of wafers, HBM and packaging still tight.
AMD.src: Investing.com (Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference transcript summary)

AVGO.headline: Hock Tan at Goldman Sachs conference: AI revenue seen at $115B in 2027 and $230B in 2028, both supply-constrained
AVGO.why: Tan said the main limit is data-center build-out (power, permitting, transformers), not chip output; Broadcom works with six frontier-model customers including OpenAI, Google and Anthropic
AVGO.src: Investing.com (Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference transcript summary)

AVGO.headline: Macquarie upgrades Broadcom to Outperform, raises price target 12% to $490
AVGO.why: Analyst Arthur Lai says Google's in-house chip threat is already priced in after a ~24% slide from the 2026 high, and forecasts over $40B of Anthropic purchases in FY2028

INTC.headline: Intel Foundry and ASML say High-NA EUV is in volume production, with over 1 million wafers processed
INTC.why: Intel says High-NA EUV is now used in volume production on select layers of some Core Ultra Series 3 (Panther Lake) chips, with overlay, throughput and availability meeting its expectations
INTC.src: Intel press release (intc.com); ASML press release

INTC.headline: DIGITIMES: Intel plans about 10% PC CPU price increase around Oct 5, its third hike since late 2025
INTC.why: Supply-chain sources say Tan is putting margins first and may drop low-margin Small Core parts. Intel hasn't confirmed; shares rose as much as 9.5% after the report
INTC.src: DIGITIMES (via Yahoo Finance/BeInCrypto, The Motley Fool)

INTC.headline: Northland upgrades Intel to Outperform from Market Perform with a $120 price target
INTC.why: Gus Richard cited the turnaround, a server CPU shortage and the Terafab foundry deal; it reverses his May downgrade

INTC.headline: Mizuho keeps Intel at Hold and cuts its price target to $92 from $109
INTC.why: Vijay Rakesh cited chip-sector rotation, the post-Q2 selloff with no outside 18A customer commitments, and dilution from the August equity raise

TSM.headline: TSMC August revenue NT$514.81B, up 53.3% YoY and 10.1% MoM; Jan-Aug NT$3,386.87B, up 39.3%
TSM.why: Monthly revenue is up for a fourth straight month, which Investing.com attributes mainly to AI chip demand and sales of its most advanced processes

TSM.headline: TSMC and ASML launch industry push to 12-inch photomasks for High NA EUV; TSMC plans High NA in volume production from 2030
TSM.why: First timeline from TSMC for using High NA EUV in advanced-node production; targets a 12-inch mask pilot line by 2031 and production use by 2033, which ASML says will raise fab productivity and lower chipmaking costs

ASML.headline: TSMC and Samsung commit to ASML High NA EUV tools, becoming its 2nd and 3rd High NA customers after Intel
ASML.why: CNBC reports Samsung targets DRAM manufacturing by 2028 and TSMC high-volume advanced-node production from 2030; each machine costs about $400M

ASML.headline: ASML and TSMC launch industry initiative to move from 6-inch to 12-inch photomasks for High NA EUV
ASML.why: It targets a 12-inch mask pilot line by 2031 and production readiness by 2033, which ASML says raises fab productivity and cuts costs for High NA users

ASML.headline: Intel Foundry and ASML say High NA EUV has processed over 1 million wafers and is in production for Core Ultra Series 3
ASML.why: Shows High NA running in production at Intel, with reticle stitching letting customers use it on today's 6-inch masks

MU.headline: Micron reportedly plans to roughly double HBM capacity to ~100K wafers/month by end-2026, adding more 12-high HBM4
MU.why: Per the reports, Micron is shifting output toward 12-high HBM4 for Nvidia's Vera Rubin to narrow the capacity gap with SK Hynix and Samsung; this is unconfirmed by Micron and attributed to unnamed sources

MRVL.headline: Marvell CEO reaffirms ~$12B FY27 and ~$18B FY28 revenue outlook at Citi's 2026 Global TMT Conference
MRVL.why: Management restated the targets first raised on the Aug 27 Q2 call, plus ~$1B of FY27 supplier capacity prepayments and a 38-40% operating margin goal; some Sept 9 coverage wrongly calls the targets new
MRVL.src: Investing.com (Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference transcript summary)

MRVL.headline: Marvell to showcase end-to-end AI data center connectivity and CXL memory portfolio at AI Infra Summit 2026
MRVL.why: Company press release covering next-gen switching, telemetry, optical interconnects and CXL memory; StockStory reported shares closed up 4.1% at $234.45 that day

9988.headline: Alibaba set to lead a $300M round in AI model-testing startup UniPat AI at a $2.5B valuation, according to sources
9988.why: Another AI investment by Alibaba. Tencent and HSG (formerly Sequoia China) are also in the round, and UniPat's founder Li Kuan worked at Alibaba's Tongyi Lab

9988.headline: Alibaba Cloud's new QoderWake version lets AI 'digital employees' work inside ByteDance's Feishu and Tencent's WeCom as well as DingTalk
9988.why: Opens a new front against ByteDance and Tencent in enterprise AI, since Alibaba's agents can now run inside rival office platforms

9988.headline: FBI, NSA and CISA alert names Alibaba among six Chinese AI firms accused of copying US AI models through distillation
9988.why: The US agencies describe 'industrial-scale' distillation of US frontier models since at least 2024. China called the claims groundless and its Commerce Ministry threatened 'resolute countermeasures'. The alert adds US regulatory risk for Qwen and Alibaba Cloud
9988.src: NBC News; CNN; Bloomberg; Al Jazeera

9988.headline: Bernstein cuts Alibaba price target to $165 from $180 and keeps Outperform, citing concerns about the equity raise
9988.why: Analyst Robin Zhu said investors questioned the timing and optics of the $10.2B raise when Alibaba holds $30.7B of net cash. Bernstein still backs the capex plan, saying the payback periods for datacenters and the M890 chip look favorable

0700.headline: Tencent to sell ~US$400M of Bilibili shares and buy US$200M of Bilibili's 2031 convertible notes in a swap
0700.why: Tencent said on 9 Sep it sold 26.37M Bilibili shares at HK$115.38 and keeps the net proceeds; the US$200M note buy and Bilibili's US$200M buyback of Tencent-held shares still need Bilibili EGM approval
0700.src: Bilibili Inc. press release (GlobeNewswire, 2026-09-04); completion release 2026-09-09 (Stock Titan)

3690.headline: Brazil's Cade rejects Keeta appeal against 99's restaurant exclusivity deals, orders wider food-delivery antitrust review
3690.why: Meituan's Keeta loses its bid to get rival 99's (Didi) exclusivity terms stopped right away, so those contracts stay in force while Cade looks at the wider sector; iFood also filed a predatory-pricing complaint against Keeta in late August

9618.headline: Arete Research downgrades JD.com to Hold from Strong-Buy with a US$30 price target
9618.why: A rating cut from a broker that covers JD; the same source puts consensus at 8 Buy, 5 Hold, 1 Sell with a US$35.25 target on the US-listed shares (1 ADS = 2 shares of 9618)
9618.src: Daily Political (MarketBeat-syndicated), 2026-09-09, reporting Arete Research note released Monday 2026-09-07

6181.headline: JPMorgan keeps Overweight on Laopu Gold, target HK$891; forecasts Q3/Q4 profit of about RMB0.8bn/1.2bn
6181.why: JPMorgan sees the Q2 sales slowdown as cyclical, not structural, and names the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays as the next test of the earnings recovery it expects

6181.headline: Shenwan Hongyuan keeps Buy on Laopu Gold with HK$639.25 target, based on 13x 2027 adjusted P/E
6181.why: Keeps adjusted net profit forecasts of RMB6.50bn/7.45bn/8.46bn for 2026-28 and cites premium positioning, membership base and overseas growth as long-term drivers
